title: Resting the Stars
setup: November 29, 2012. The Spurs are in Miami to play the Heat on the last stop of a road trip. Coach Gregg Popovich sends Tim Duncan, Manu Ginobili, Tony Parker and Danny Green home before the game.
question: What does commissioner David Stern do?
options: Nothing. Who plays is the coach's call.
He suspends Popovich for a game.
ruling: Stern fined the Spurs $250,000. He said, "The result here is dictated by the totality of the facts in this case," and added, "Under these circumstances, I have concluded that the Spurs did a disservice to the league and our fans."
rulebookNote: The NBA said the Spurs broke a league policy against resting players in a way that is "contrary to the best interests of the NBA."
